title: Pre-Christmas rate hike unlikely as unemployment rate jumps to highest level in five years
paragraphs: Unemployment has surged to 4.9% in October, from 4.7%, in a shock increase that will add to rising worries the economy has passed a tipping point following this year’s five interest rate increases.
New figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics showed the number of employed people dropped by 43,500 in the month, confounding forecasts for jobs growth and a steady jobless rate.
After starting the year at 4%, unemployment has now lifted to its highest level in five years to approach pre-Covid levels.
